show_level_overview.label: Show the phantom job level overview in the main window
show_level_overview.tooltip:
Lists the current and max level (max taken from the game data) of all 13 phantom jobs in the main window.
Display only, it never changes your job; to switch automatically when a job is maxed, start "Phantom job leveling" in the Automation section at the top of the main window.

panel.title: Phantom Job Levels
panel.not_loaded: Phantom job state not available (loading or not in Occult Crescent)

tooltip.no_max:
No max level in the game data: this phantom job does not level from combat experience.
Phantom job leveling skips it, and switches away to the next unmaxed phantom job while you are on it.

leveling.switching: Phantom job leveling: about to switch to
leveling.nothing: Phantom job leveling: no other unlocked phantom job below max level
leveling.waiting: Phantom job leveling: switches once the current phantom job is maxed
leveling.tooltip:
Only switches out of combat, outside F.A.T.E.s and Critical Engagements, and while BOCCHI has no other action in progress; with Illegal Mode running it switches between two activities.
The next job is searched in job order, skipping locked, maxed and non-experience phantom jobs.
